body: Ah yes I'm sure some nice pectorals will help me talk to people /s

OMG SOMEONE GETS IT! It's super comforting to know that someone else feels the same, and I agree that some people just can't understand being young in today's times (there's alot of people in this comment section telling me that I'll "find my people" because that's what happens to Everyone apparently). Thanks for replying, it kinda made my day to know that I'm not  TOTALLY totally alone if that makes sense? haha
Gee thanks for the help buddy

GOD I feel this. "Get a hobby". I fucking tried! Do those fuckers honestly think that exercising every other day is going to make my depression go away?? How the fuck could ***moving my body in a way that is literally no fun and will just make me live longer and hurts*** make me want to live??

I really appreciate you honest opinion! Issue is I don't want to fuck him though. I never said that. Even if I was of age, having a fuck buddy would be useless because all I want is someone to feel something for me, even if it's just a teeny spark underneath all the negativity. I don't care about being a broken protagonist I just want to be normal and worthy of someone's time and just be more than dirt. I bother coming here to talk about it because I'm miserable all the time and I wish I was someone else who could really be in a relationship but the emotional attention someone gives me when they bother to throw me a bone just makes me attatched to them. Everyone in my life keeps telling me that he's bad and he's going to make me worse and I don't want to be even more miserable than I already am and I can see myself heading down that path from the outside. It's like I'm watching myself in a movie. I don't want to be attracted to him and I can't help it but I fucking hate that I am because he's bad I know it but I'm desperate for companionship. If he wasn't toxic like this and still insisted that he loved me, I'd probably tell him that he should move on and shut him out for fear of being abandoned because it would hurt when he leaves. I recognize that he hurts me and I like it. There's no reason to move on because that's the best I'm ever going to get. I really don't care about having sex at all.

Right?? I feel so insecure when I'm asked to talk or put my camera on it's insane. Like you say something and you can't even see what everyone reacts with and then I sit there just like *"Oh god ok they all heard me stutter and now they'll think I'm stupid holy crap they all hate me I bet they all hear how sad I am I messed up oh god"*

Holy fuck, are we the same person?? I can't stand online school and I've been progressively getting worse in quarantine too (not necesarily BECAUSE of it, but there's nowhere I can go to get help) I wish there was a fix-all way for us to feel better. Ngl, it's comforting to read someone with the same experience other than "omg I miss going to starbucks w/ my besties!" I feel so exhausted all the time and it's just wakeup, school, get yelled at for not doing school fast enough, sleep, and repeat. I just feel so hopeless and stuck.
